title: segmented slab compact latch and fragmentation-aware eviction scoring
author: Maya Patel
description:
Title: Segmented slab compact latch and fragmentation-aware eviction scoring

Motivation: Production serving workloads continue to hit pathological fragmentation in the KV cache when tenants vary widely in allocation patterns. This causes premature OOMs and noisy spill behaviour that degrades tail latency. This PR introduces a compact-on-spill 'compact latch' that allows background compaction of underutilized segments, plus a fragmentation-aware eviction score that biases evictions towards high-fragmentation regions. The design minimizes allocations on the hot path and integrates with the async spill writer and scheduler to keep tail latency steady.

Changes (high level):
- Add compact_latch module (background compactor coordinator) that pins a segment for compaction without blocking fast-path lookups.
- Segmented slab manager: track per-segment occupancy histograms and fragmentation metrics; expose low-cost sampling APIs.
- Evictor: new fragmentation_score combined with recency/size to prefer draining fragmented segments first.
- Spill writer: non-blocking async spill with prioritized batching for compaction-triggered spill tasks.
- Scheduler: worker_pool now accepts 'background' hints so compaction tasks are scheduled on lower-priority workers to preserve foreground throughput.
- Tests and docs: integration test proving stable P95 under mixed allocation workloads; ops doc describing knobs and expected tradeoffs.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc: ENG-9284 (linked)
- [x] Unit tests for eviction scoring
- [x] Integration test for compact latch end-to-end
- [x] Metrics and tracing added for compaction events
- [x] Docs updated with tuning guidance

Commits (summary):
- 91d4a2e: initial compact latch scaffold and interfaces
- b3f77a1: histogram sampling and per-seg occupancy accounting
- 5c2b8f0: fragmentation-aware eviction heuristic and unit tests
- 7e9a113: async spill writer priority queue and backpressure fix
- 2f4c6d9: scheduler worker hints and doc updates

Files changed (high level):
- runtime/kv/segmented_slab_manager.rs: add per-segment histogram, sampling, API for compaction candidates.
- runtime/kv/compact_latch.rs: new background compaction coordinator (non-blocking latch semantics).
- runtime/kv/evictor.rs: compute fragmentation_score, update eviction comparator.
- runtime/kv/spill_writer.rs: introduce priority queues and non-blocking I/O path.
- runtime/scheduler/worker_pool.rs: add background hints and starvation guard.
- tests/kv/compact_latch_integration_test.rs: workload reproducer and assertions for p95/p99.
- docs/ops/kv-memory-tuning.md: operational guidance and example configs.

Review conversation (selected):
- Julien Park (reviewer): "The compact latch looks good; I'm concerned about raced pins when multiple compactors pick the same segment. Can we add an optimistic compare-and-swap and a short jittered backoff?"
- Author (Maya Patel): "Added CAS + jittered backoff in compact_latch.rs (b3f77a1). Also added a metric compact_latch_conflicts_total so ops can observe contention."
- Samira Khan (reviewer): "Eviction heuristic may oscillate under steady churn. Suggest adding a decay window on fragmentation_score so we don't thrash."
- Author: "Implemented exponential decay with configurable half-life (default 10s). See evictor.rs changes and docs."
- Owen Marks (approver): "Verified benchmark: 18% P95 improvement and 12% lower bytes spilled under mixed-tenant workload. Approving."

CI: Initial run failed (race detected in test compact_latch_integration_test) — fixed by adding a small synchronization barrier and rerunning. Final CI: all checks passed (unit, integration, lint, fmt).

Benchmark summary (internal):
- Mixed-tenants synthetic (60% small keys, 40% large blobs): P95 latency reduced 18%; P99 unchanged; total bytes spilled down 12%.
- Memory usage: peak resident set reduced 6% over 1h steady-state due to more effective compaction.

Operational notes / release notes:
- Adds compact-on-spill background compaction to reduce fragmentation-induced OOMs. Default config is conservative; operators can tune compaction aggressiveness via runtime.flags.kv.compaction_rate and kv.fragmentation_half_life.
- New metrics: kv_compaction_events_total, compact_latch_conflicts_total, kv_fragmentation_score{segment} and kv_spill_priority_histogram.

Merge outcome: Squash merged into main. Rollout plan: feature gated behind runtime.flags.kv.compaction_enabled (default true for rollout stage 1). Monitor kv_compaction_events_total and kv_spill_bytes_total for unexpected regressions.

Related work: ENG-9421 (follow-up to expose compaction metrics to console), SUP-4123 (customer incident that motivated more deterministic spill behavior).
release_notes:
- Background compact-on-spill to reduce KV cache fragmentation
- Fragmentation-aware eviction scoring to prioritize compacting cold fragmented regions
- New metrics and operator knobs for tuning compaction
notes_for_ops: Default behavior is conservative. If you see excessive compaction going on, increase runtime.flags.kv.compaction_rate or raise kv.fragmentation_threshold. For high-throughput tenants, prefer keeping compaction_enabled=true but set compaction_rate to lower values to avoid impacting foreground latency.
summary: Introduces compact latch and fragmentation-aware eviction to reduce KB-level fragmentation and spill churn; merged via squash after reviewers approved and CI passed.
